mentions.name: YourPods
mentions.description: YourPods is a minimalist, gPodder-compatible podcast player focused on the iOS ecosystem (WatchOS/CarPlay/AirPlay). It is privacy-first and self-hosted, syncing subscriptions and listening progress across devices via the user's own Nextcloud server, with support for multiple profiles so users keep their data 100% theirs.
mentions.problem: Podcast listeners want to keep their subscription and listening data 100% theirs, with privacy-first sync instead of relying on a third-party service.
mentions.source_excerpt: Minimalist Podcast player with gPodder sync focused on iOS ecosystem. (WatchOS/CarPlay/AirPlay).
